load_sentencepiece_model: load a SentencePiece model from a file path with optional control symbols
create_basic_sentencepiece_tokenizer: create a BasicSentencePieceTokenizer that encodes text with BOS and EOS tokens
create_raw_sentencepiece_tokenizer: create a RawSentencePieceTokenizer that encodes text with no control symbols
encode_text_with_sentencepiece: encode text to token indices using a SentencePieceEncoder with prefix and suffix tokens
get_sentencepiece_vocabulary_info: get the vocabulary size and special token indices from a SentencePiece model
